defs.def: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine （报刊上的）文章，论文，报道

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

ex.s: Articles are usually received within 1-2 days and books in 5-10 days.
ex.t: 文章通常在1-2天内收到，书籍在5-10天内收到。

ex.s: Once in your account, select Electronic Articles Received.
ex.t: 进入你的账户后，选择“已收到的电子文章”。

ex.s: How much do you pay for two articles obtained from an international library?
ex.t: 从国际图书馆获取两篇文章你要付多少钱？

ex.s: A friend has been sending me articles on how quantum computers might help solve some of the biggest challenges we face as humans.
ex.t: 一位朋友一直在给我发文章，介绍量子计算机可能如何帮助我们解决作为人类所面临的一些最大挑战。

ex.s: I began collecting newspaper articles about new species, new monkey, new spider…, and on and on they appear.
ex.t: 我开始收集关于新物种、新猴子、新蜘蛛……的报纸文章，它们源源不断地出现。

ex.s: What was the author’s initial purpose of collecting newspaper articles?
ex.t: 作者最初收集报纸文章的目的是什么？

ex.s: Magazine Articles More Valuable Than You May Think
ex.t: 继续阅读阅读杂志给年轻读者带来的好处以及如何向孩子介绍这种媒介。

ex.s: Magazine articles can provide reluctant readers with a lively, breezy writing style that can inspire them to read more.
ex.t: 杂志文章能以生动、轻松的写作风格为不情愿的读者提供灵感，鼓励他们多阅读。

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我只会在穿着白大褂的情况下编辑PsyBlog的文章，以帮助减少打字错误的数量。

ex.s: Last week, Anne was attracted by a particular article in a magazine, so she bought it.
ex.t: 上周，安妮被杂志上的一篇文章吸引，于是她买下了那本杂志。

ex.s: Three days ago, to complete her homework quickly, she copied part of the article without thinking.
ex.t: 三天前，为了快速完成作业，她想都没想就抄了文章的一部分。

ex.s: Dear Editor, Your article about living in a global village really struck a chord with me because I’ve just returned from a teaching project in Cambodia and Thailand.
ex.t: 亲爱的编辑，您那篇关于生活在"地球村"的文章真的引起了我的共鸣，因为我刚从柬埔寨和泰国的一个教学项目回来。

ex.s: Edgar Snow was an American journalist who wrote influential books and articles about China in the 1930s.
ex.t: 埃德加·斯诺是一位美国记者，他在二十世纪三十年代写了关于中国的有影响力的书籍和文章。

ex.s: Writing an article about the Aral Sea.
ex.t: 写一篇关于咸海的文章。

ex.s: She’d just look up at the right time, long enough to answer-in character - “The better to eat you with, my dear,” and go back to her place in the magazine article.
ex.t: 她只是在恰当的时候抬起头——足够长的时间——用角色的语气回答："这样我就能更好地吃掉你了，亲爱的，"然后回到她的杂志文章那里去。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 我17岁时，读到一篇杂志文章，介绍一家叫麦克奈的博物馆，它曾是水彩画家玛丽安·麦克奈的故居。她曾要求社区在她去世后将其改为博物馆。一个阳光明媚的周六，萨莉和我开车去了博物馆。她问："你有地址吗？""没有，但我会认出来的，杂志上有照片。"

ex.s: For an article or book chapter, you will be notified by email when it is available.
ex.t: 对于文章或书籍章节，当其可用时，你会收到电子邮件通知。

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

ex.s: A few years later, still attracted to the country, he returned to Uzbekistan to write an article about the disappearance of the Aral Sea.
ex.t: 几年后，他依然为这个国家着迷，便重返乌兹别克斯坦，写一篇关于咸海消失的文章。

ex.s: A research article.
ex.t: 一篇研究文章。

ex.s: How can the man improve his article?
ex.t: 男士如何改进他的文章？

ex.s: How can the man improve his article?
ex.t: 男士如何改进他的文章？

ex.s: On Thursday in an article published in Cell, a team of researchers reported a new kind of adaptation - not to air or to food, but to the ocean.
ex.t: 周四，一个研究团队在《细胞》发表的文章中报告了一种新的适应——不是对空气或食物，而是对海洋。

ex.s: How can the man improve his article?
ex.t: 男士如何改进他的文章？

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短，这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读，而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣。

ex.s: Library Type Loan Cost Article/Chapter Cost
ex.t: 图书馆类型 借阅费用 文章/章节费用

defs.def: a separate item in an agreement or a contract （协议、契约的）条款，项
a particular item or separate thing, especially one of a set 物件，物品（尤指整套中的一件）
the words a and an (the indefinite article) or the (the definite article) 冠词（a 和 an 为不定冠词，the 为定冠词）

ex.s: Priestley wrote many successful articles, essays, novels and plays, but is best remembered for his play An Inspector Calls.
ex.t: 听演讲，选出听到的句子。/一个年轻人正和一位在礼堂工作的女士说话。
